title: MycelicMemory
description: I built MycelicMemory — an MCP server that gives any coding agent a robust, semantically indexed, knowledge-graph-backed memory system that is fully local and secure. Sub-100ms hybrid search, automatic capture from your coding sessions, zero cloud dependency, and it works with Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client. I always use it when I code.

title: Lexie
description: An AI agent that makes the contractor calls you don't want to make. Describe the problem in a chat thread and Lexie fans out real outbound calls to local vendors in parallel, quotes the same scope to each one, negotiates the appointment, and books it — recorded and transcribed, and nothing dials until you confirm.

title: Parallely
description: I built Parallely — a CLI that splits one large coding task into sections and runs them concurrently, one AI coding agent per section, all in a shared git worktree. A fullscreen TUI streams every agent's live progress, output, and token usage, and finished sections auto-commit to a shared integration branch. Backend-agnostic — it drives Codex, Claude Code, or OpenCode.
